import { defineTable, col } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "type" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "recipient_type" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const noticedNotifications = defineTable("noticed_notifications", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
        type: col.text(),
        eventId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        recipientType: col.text().notNull(),
        recipientId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        readAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }),
        seenAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }),
        createdAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }).notNull(),
        updatedAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }).notNull()
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
